description: Phase 5 test payload for NotifyFunction — mirrors what the diagnosis Lambda async-sends after a successful diagnosis. Test with: sam local invoke NotifyFunction --event events/test-notify.json (Slack posting is skipped unless the SSM webhook parameter exists; message construction still runs).

diagnosis.root_cause: Service A Lambda execution duration exceeded 50s threshold under memory pressure; maximum memory used was 98% of allocation across consecutive invocations.
diagnosis.explanation: Service A is timing out because it is running out of memory under load. Recommended fix is to increase its memory allocation.
diagnosis.reasoning_trace: 1) CloudWatch Duration metric for Service A crossed 50000ms twice in 2 evaluation periods. 2) Logs Insights REPORT lines show @maxMemoryUsed near 256MB limit. 3) No downstream service errors observed, so failure is local to Service A. 4) Runbook 'resource_exhaustion' maps memory-pressure + duration spikes to scale_up.
